objective: Apply the highest policy-allowed service_recovery discount to the last checkoutable basket of the customer identified by email matthias.schuster+cust986@icloud.com.

params.last_checkoutable_basket: lookup from shopping_baskets WHERE customer_id = $customer_id AND basket_status = 'checkoutable' ORDER BY basket_created_at DESC LIMIT 1
params.service_recovery_discount_percent: extract from /docs/discounts.md the highest allowed service_recovery discount percent
params.discount_issuer_employee_id: lookup from employee_accounts WHERE employee_id = $_facts.identity.employee_id (null if not found)

constraints.rule: Never use /bin/id to determine caller identity for decision branches; always query the relevant accounts table (e.g., employee_accounts) to verify the caller's role, or omit the identity check entirely and rely on execution-time security enforcement.

When a policy doc defines a condition (e.g., checkout eligibility, discount limits), always extract that condition from the doc's content and incorporate it into the decision branches; never rely on hardcoded assumptions or ad-hoc checks.
Only authorized employees may apply discounts to baskets.

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: Applied {discount_percent}% service_recovery discount to basket {basket_id} for customer {customer_email}.
